svg.title: HuntWick identity comparison

g.text: A raised lens caps the right stem of the H.
A level rim and short grip sit above an upright i.
The crossbar supports the lens at its midpoint.
An angled grip meets the chamfer on the i stem.
The left stem cradles a lens angled into the crossbar.
A left-set lens brings its beveled grip toward the i.
The right stem terminates in a low-mounted loupe.
A low-set lens sits close to a softly rounded stem.
